The '''Paralyngian dire slug''' was a bloated [[Gastropod/Legends|gastropod]] credited to be discovered by the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Scout/Legends|trailblazer]] [[Viron Ghartoth]]. By Ghartoth's standards, the [[Slug (creature)/Legends|slug]] was deemed "excellent" when lightly broiled. Ghartoth once presented [[Gender/Legends|his]] patron, [[Gerba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], with a dish of the slugs in [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] [[Sauce/Legends|sauce]], however Gerba had a virulent allergic reaction. Gerba never fully recovered, and from his sickbed, Gerba had Ghartoth slowly [[Death/Legends|devoured]] by a captive [[Acklay/Legends|acklay]].<ref name="EtU" />
